text:
elaine: Quick design check: when approving items from a regression diff (in Eval runs), do we want the UI to: (A) update inline and show an Undo toast, or (B) open the diff panel to show changed examples? thinking inline + toast is lower friction.
maria: inline + toast aligns with other flows. but we need to be clear about where focus stays and how SRs are informed.
kevin: implementation thought: update list rows in-place, emit analytics event approval.bulk, show a small top-right toast "Approved 5 examples. Undo". avoid focus traps.
asha: accessibility rules: toasts must use role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true". do NOT move focus to the updated rows automatically. user should choose to explore the diff panel. include an offscreen live region for score deltas: e.g., "Scorecard updated: 2 regressions introduced, 0 resolved."
jon: microcopy nit: prefer action-first toast "Approved 5 examples" (not "5 examples approved"). CTA label = "Undo" (sentence case). Timeout 6s.
maria: keyboard flow: after approve, focus remains on the bulk toolbar. Tab order should allow keyboard users to reach the toast Undo then the persistent score pill. Esc should dismiss toast and return focus to the bulk toolbar.
asha: SR test steps to add to PR: (1) select items, (2) trigger approve, (3) assert SR reads "Approved X examples. Press Undo to revert.", (4) Tab to Undo -> Enter -> assert SR reads "Reverted X examples." include Esc path. Also test the pill opens diff panel and is focusable.
kevin: ok i'll implement aria-live & aria-atomic. question: should the score pill include both visual counts and an aria-label describing regressions?
maria: yes, pill visual text = "5 approved" and aria-describedby points to the hidden SR node with the score delta text. keep pill focusable and add tooltip "View regression diff".
jon: performance note: bulk-approve should batch server calls (50 per request). when a large batch is in progress show progressive visual text "Approving 120 of 300..." but only announce the final result to SRs.
asha: correct — intermediate updates should be visual only. final announce via the live region.
deploy-bot: UAT deployed: feature/inline-approve-toast for testing.
maria: assigning @kevin to implement, @asha to write SR acceptance tests, @jon to add analytics spec. will review after UAT smoke tests. Thanks! :sparkles:
